text:
Sam (Support): FYI raising to CS — IntegraSync trial onboarding stalled, customer hitting 403 on embed provisioning, SSO not completing. Usage 0/1000 tokens, trial ends in 10 days. Renewal risk if we don't unblock. attaching logs.

Maria (CS): ack — can you paste the provisioning error & when it started?

Sam (Support): here's the error we saw:
```
ERROR 403: provisioning/embeds - missing org_key
request_id: rq_abc123
```
Started 2026-03-18 09:12PT. They also report SSO shows "Pending" in admin console.

Alex G: looping in solutions. I'll take the SSO config walkthrough if we can align times. Prefer Thu morning CET. Sam, do we have contact + timezone?

Sam (Support): Primary contact: jordan@integrasync.com, TZ: CET (UTC+1). They prefer morning CET. Jordan said "we tried linking Okta, but redirect URL rejects".

Tina - AM: This looks high priority — potential churn. Proposed comms plan: (1) CS-led SSO session w/ solutions + support shadow (2) temporary token grant so they can complete ingest/tests (short-term) (3) 48h check-in cadence. Who can own the temp token request?

Maria (CS): I can own coordination. @Alex G you okay for Thu 11am CET for the walkthrough? If that's rough we can shift.

Alex G: Thu 11am CET works for me. I'll prep a short SSO checklist and redirect_url examples.

ops-bot: PROVISION_EVENT: customer=integraSync status=failed code=403

Sam (Support): I'll request a temp token from infra and escalate quota. ETA ~3h.

Maria (CS): Draft comms plan: 
- Immediate: email Jordan acknowledging escalation + propose Thu 11am CET call (Maria)
- Prep: SSO checklist + redirect URL sample (Alex)
- Short-term: temporary token for embed testing (Sam)
- Follow-up: 48h status update + NPS pulse if unblocked (Tina)
Reactions: :eyes: :calendar:

Tina - AM: Approve. If not unblocked in 48h, escalate to Senior AM & Sales for renewal outreach. I'll add renewal_watch tag in CRM.

Sam (Support): quick note — customer has a 3rd-party Okta rule that rewrites redirect_url, might be root cause.

Maria (CS): Good catch. Sam, can you get the exact plugin/app name? Jordan, can you confirm any IdP rewrite rules?

Jordan (Customer): Jordan: yes — we have a URL-rewrite rule on the Okta app called "redirect-fixer". Turning it off now, will confirm in 10m.

Sam (Support): update: Jordan confirmed rewrite disabled. Re-running provisioning tests.

ops-bot: PROVISION_EVENT: customer=integraSync status=success code=200

Sam (Support): provisioning success. Recommend proceeding with session to validate end-to-end.

Maria (CS): Session confirmed Thu 11am CET. I'll send calendar invite and include pre-call checklist. Owners: Maria (coord), Alex (SSO walkthrough), Sam (infra/temp token), Tina (renewal owner). Marking thread P1 -> internal SLA 48h. :thumbsup:

Tina - AM: noted, renewal_watch tag added.

Sam (Support): closing escalation from support side. I'll post the final playbook/checklist after the call.

Maria (CS): thanks team — will update CRM and post final notes after session. :white_check_mark:
